tools.name: check_mcp_server
tools.description: Check a public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP) for readiness for the Claude Directory, ChatGPT Apps, Gemini Connected Apps and the MCP Registry. Returns the 0-100 score, A-F grade, readiness per store, every failing or warning check with its fix, the report URL and README badge markdown. Res

tools.name: explain_check
tools.description: Explain one McpStamp Check rule by its id (for example tool_annotations or auth_prm): what it tests, why stores need it, which stores it blocks, its weight and the store or spec documents it comes from. Use it after check_mcp_server to understand a failing check.
